signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: See and download your photos. Use the email or phone number Areli has on file.
signIn.photoAlt: A couple walking toward the Superstition Mountains, a tiny onesie line between them
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Text or message Areli and she'll send you a new one.

errors.identifierRequired: Enter your email or phone number.
errors.wrong: That email or phone and password don't match.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a complete phone number, like (480) 555-0123.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like you@email.com.

password.title: Choose your password
password.subtitle: Choose your own password to see your photos. You'll use it from now on.

rules.noName: Doesn’t contain your first or last name

errors.sameAsTemporary: Choose a password different from the one we sent you.
errors.alreadyChosen: Your password was already chosen. Sign in with it.

galleries.title: Your galleries
galleries.expiredNote: These galleries expired and their photos were removed. Message Areli if you need something from them.

empty.title: No galleries yet
empty.body: Your photos will appear here as soon as Areli delivers them. We'll email you.

gallery.expiresToday: This gallery closes today. Save the photos you want to keep.
gallery.expiresSoon_one: This gallery closes tomorrow ({{date}}). Save the photos you want to keep.
gallery.expiresSoon_other: This gallery closes in {{count}} days ({{date}}). Save the photos you want to keep.
gallery.favoritesLimit: You can pick up to {{count}} favorites.
gallery.favoritesEmpty: Tap the heart on a photo to add it here.
gallery.favoriteFailed: Couldn't update the favorite. Try again.

viewer.label: Photo {{n}} of {{total}}
viewer.pickSecond: Pick the second photo from the strip below
viewer.editBusy: Another edit is still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
viewer.editInvalid: That edit can't be made. Check the size and try again.

errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.

download.title: Download
download.webNote: Web copy, reduced quality. Great for sharing.
download.preparing: Your download is starting. Large ZIPs can take a minute.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.inTool: Zoom in: click the photo, or press again to zoom at the center
zoom.outTool: Zoom out: click the photo, or press again to zoom out from the center

edit.straightenNote: Fix a tilted horizon. The photo is trimmed slightly to fill the frame.
edit.resultNote: {{pct}}% of the pixels. It only gets smaller, never enlarged. Your edit is made when you download; nothing is saved.

info.error: The photo info could not be loaded.
info.name: Name
info.print: Prints sharp up to about {{long}} × {{short}} in.
info.locationHint: The coordinates stay inside your original file; they are not shown here.
info.noCamera: This file has no camera data (it may have been exported or edited).

hint.shutterFast: Fast enough for people, without blur.
hint.shutterSlow: Slow: needs a steady hand or a tripod.
hint.shutterVerySlow: Very slow: only for a tripod.
hint.apertureWide: Wide open: sharp subject, soft blurred background.
hint.apertureBalanced: Balanced: subject sharp, background gently soft.
hint.apertureNarrow: Narrow: most of the scene in focus.
hint.isoMedium: Medium: a little grain in the shadows.
hint.isoHigh: High: shot in low light, visible grain.
hint.focalWide: Wide angle: takes in the whole scene.
hint.focalNatural: Natural view, close to what the eye sees.
hint.focalLongTele: Long telephoto: brings distant subjects close.

bookings.title: Your sessions
bookings.requestedNote: Areli confirms every session by hand. She'll text or email you soon.
bookings.depositNote: Send the deposit to hold your date →

empty.upcomingBody: When you book with Areli, your session will show up here.

howToPay.title: How to pay
howToPay.note: Add your name and session date to the note. Areli confirms each payment by hand.
howToPay.askAreli: Text Areli to pay with Zelle or Cash App.
